citations.assessment: The direct narrative names the two and gives the explicit Sabbath question and objections to Shemayah and Avtalyon. The sectarian affiliation is Heilprin’s inference, and the Peah name occurrence remains open.
Checked Peah and Kiddushin give Yudan as maternal grandson of R. Shimon ben Yochai. Heilprin names ben Dorti and treats the ruling as Shimon’s; retain this reading with a witness qualification.
